metrics.method: Programmatic pass over all 1,491 non-service messages (2025-09-14 to 2026-09-11); client side = {Alex Paige, Ethan Ok} (860 msgs) per config/clients.yaml, our side = all 16 other senders (631 msgs). client_questions_total = client messages containing a literal '?' (65); a broader count including explicit non-'?' requests ('can you', 'please', 'wondering', 'any update') gives 109. unanswered_over_24h = 18, hand-counted episodes where a client question or request got no substantive human answer within 24h OR needed a repeat nudge ('??', 'Guys?', 'Did we find out?', 'Hey?'); a strict literal 'no team message of any kind within 24h' test scores only 21 raw gaps and understates the problem because templated invoices and leak reports keep the clock alive. Three of the 18 were never answered at all: where to upload nude content (2025-11-15), whether she could reach the owner (2026-07-06), and her rebuttal on the $1,989 dispute (2026-07-28, 45 days). max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive our-side messages, 2026-08-01 19:09 -> 2026-08-10 11:14; for reference her two longest silences were 12.7d and 12.6d and neither drew outreach beyond an invoice chase. Promises tallied by hand as explicit first-person commitments by our side, then checked for on-record delivery.

what_client_wanted: To be treated as a person recovering from surgery and to have the plan adjusted around her body — she disclosed it twice, the second time unprompted: 'Hey I’ve just had surgery so probably not for a few weeks unfortunately' (2026-08-26) and 'I’m still recovering from surgery and can only be in certain positions hahah' (2026-09-02). Sixteen days on, nobody has asked how she is.

The management-run IG reels/promo accounts to actually post — her single most repeated ask, running from 'How’s the management social media accounts for me going? Xx' (2025-10-26) through 'Also has anyone been posting on the reelwithalex account' (2026-06-02) to 'Hey no videos have been uploaded to my reel page in ages | Nothing since last year' (2026-07-28). It is also the only deliverable that needs nothing from her while she recovers.

A written, substantive answer on how to lift OF earnings — asked at least five times since January: 'Hey guys money is looking crazy low… what can I do to increase this' (2026-05-26), 'How can we increase money on Of what can I do my end' (2026-06-28). She has never been given one on record.

Billing that matches her payout cycle, no surprise fees, and hard safety boundaries with fans in her own city — 'I’m never going to not pay but … I can’t really just pull 10kaus out prior to cover it until I get paid' (2025-10-08), 'I’ll just pay by transfer instead' when the 5% CC surcharge appeared (2026-07-24), and 'I don’t want people to think I’m ever ever meeting them' (2026-05-15).
what_worked: The week-1 report with real numbers in it produced the single most enthusiastic message she has ever sent us: 'Wohooo thannk you so much! Amazinf thank you so much!!!' (2025-09-23). She responds to concrete stats — and we have not sent her one in 353 days.

Same-session concrete execution on something she asked for: the link-in-bio was built and delivered inside an hour ('Yeah love it!', 2025-09-20) and the free-page switch was done overnight ('Wohoo thankyou so much!!! X | You’re the best', 2026-05-22).

Owning a failure fast, fixing it and apologising without deflecting — Nate closed the Adelaide whale-meetup reversal in 25 minutes ('Ofc, sorry abt that… Shouldn’t happen again', 2026-06-18, answered with 'Thank you very much'), and Mayson closed a 331-day-old Drive upload failure in 24 minutes on 2026-09-04 ('Let me fix that asap' → 'Can you check now @alexpaigem my apologies' → client: 'That’s worked'). These are our two best moments on this account and both are the same behaviour.
top_fix: Give this account one named owner whose standing weekly job is a single outbound message that contains a number and contains no ask. That one rule would have produced the earnings plan she asked for five times, an itemized ledger instead of a 45-day-old $1,989 dispute and four payments with no amount on record, a human reply to the surgery on Aug 26 instead of a 30-reels quota on Aug 30, proof that @paigealexxo was posting instead of 45 days of silence, and outreach inside the two 12-day client silences instead of an invoice chase — the four wounds actually pushing this account toward a quiet exit.
